en: The postcard presents a sepia-toned photograph of a river view with several sailboats and barges on the water, likely from the early 20th century. Trees and some rooftops frame the foreground, while the background shows a flat landscape with a bridge and scattered buildings. The text on the front includes 'Nijmegen', 'Gezicht op de Rivier', and publishing information at the bottom.
